title: AI Hurtles Ahead
summary:
Benjamin Graham taught you about margin of safety. The Codex team used early versions to debug its own training, manage its own deployment,
and diagnose test results and evaluations. Its willingness to take risk might not be constrained by humans' normal risk aversion.
